data.narrative:
Skyryse, a Series C-stage aerospace company, is evaluated against a comparable universe of 5 public Space & Aerospace equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Sierra Space, Varda Space Industries, and Rocket Lab.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $1.1B last post-money valuation, yielding $2.0B. Peer-median analysis across 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Sierra Space at $8.0B, Apex Space at $2.3B, Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B, Varda Space Industries at $1.5B, and Aalyria at $1.3B—produces a median of $2.0B, with a range of $1.3B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable; while the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 26.4x price-to-sales across 6 public tickers, Skyryse's revenue is not disclosed.

Triangulation of the two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $1.7B (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $2.0B. The current $1.15B valuation sits materially below this implied range. Key uncertainties include revenue-stage positioning relative to peers and the methodological sensitivity to the peer set's wide dispersion ($1.3B–$8.0B), driven partly by Sierra Space's substantial outlier valuation.
